page_texts.1: Read `.claude/commands/guidance.md` for the full workflow. Determines the architecture domain and category/type; if the domain is Security, classifies the content first and redirects to `/pattern` or `/standard` when the classification selects one of those types instead of continuing here. Otherwise checks `strategy/guidance/<domain>/<type>/` for existing guidance matching the request. If none exists, reads `strategy/guidance/architecture-guidance-creation-guidelines.md`, derives a kebab-case title slug from the request, finds the next available GUID- number, copies the template from `resources/work-templates/assets/artifacts/architecture-guidance.md`, and creates `strategy/guidance/<domain>/<type>/GUID-<DOMAIN>-<TYPE>-<NNN>-<title-slug>.md` with status `'draft'`. If one exists, revises it in place, preserving its ID and path, bumps the version, and logs the change in its Change History. Reviews against `strategy/guidance/architecture-guidance-quality-checklist.md` and updates `strategy/guidance/<domain>/README.md` either way. Ends with a convergence pass per `.claude/skills/ai-convergence/SKILL.md`. Guidance is informative implementation direction, not a mandatory requirement.
